description: Major horticultural nightshade crop grown globally in open field and greenhouses.
Cool-season root tuber sensitive to blight and excessive moisture.
Warm-season solanaceous crop susceptible to bacterial spot and mildews.
Staple grain crop vulnerable to stripe rust and powdery mildew.
Semi-aquatic grain crop susceptible to blast and bacterial blight.
Major food and fodder cereal vulnerable to southern corn leaf blight.
